summary:
w124 plan for migration-tools r24, r32, r33, r34, and the retired r24 deprecated scenario.
r32: the work status of open initiatives goes into the one SessionStart command, `migrate status --hook`. It is work status's own text at the top level, after any version text; nothing is added when no initiative is open, which keeps r24 and r28 silent.
r33/r34: a new PreCompact hook runs a new migrate subcommand (scripts/migrate_session.py). It appends `- YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM: compacted` to each open initiative's ledger and commits only those ledgers with workqueue.committed (rests on the-ledger-is-tracked and r15). It then tells the session to write its hand-off with `work note` and end. It always exits 0.
New step module tests/scenarios/migration_session_steps.py.
Tests broken: none beyond the retired scenario, which is removed.
Open cases: D2/D3 work status edge cases, a commit failure, repeated compacted lines, whether PreCompact stdout reaches the model.
